sources.title: Architecture graph for RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-BF16.
sources.snippet: RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-BF16 architecture at a glance RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-BF16 is a text-generation model (glm5_next_text architecture). It uses 45 transformer layers, a hidden size of 4,096, and multi-head latent attention (MLA). The feed-forward layers use a mixture-of-experts design with 288 experts (8 active per token, 1 always-on).
